case_number: 2025 INSC 102; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 928 OF 2025, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 929 OF 2025

parties.petitioner: Surendra G. Shankar & Anr., Dilip Kumar

summary: Delay condonation in RERA appeals; High Court erred in refusing condonation after acknowledging delay ought to have been condoned; limited scope of appeal against refusal to condone delay; merits not to be examined without condonation; RERA orders not binding on Appellate Tribunal; appeals allowed, delay condoned, restored for adjudication on merits; no opinion on underlying RERA orders.
legal_provisions_cited: Ram Kali Devi (Smt) v. Manager, Punjab National Bank, Shamshabad and Others, (1998) 9 SCC 558
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; delay condoned; appeals restored to Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai for decision on merits.
